name: Narita Gonzou
source:
Specialty: Arithmetic
Hobby: Travel
Likes: Sake, night life
Dislikes: Vegetarian food

A man who amassed wealth and became nouveau riche from special wartime procurements. Characterized by his arrogance, he often haughtily waves around money and relies solely on it. In an age where there is a huge disparity between the rich and poor, his attitude has earned him the scorn of the common people.

[i]"Gahaha! Get me everything in this damned store; if you want money, I got it!"[i]
